title: The Ultimate Chess Player's Weakness
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji weighed the pros and cons, a weary sigh echoed from the depths of the Fate Vortex—an elderly voice, Mo Xiansheng's warning: 'Chen Ji, the chess game from ten thousand years ago never truly ended. Are you prepared to hear the truth?'

text.content: The howling of the Fate Vortex tore through the air like razor-sharp shrieks. Chen Ji felt his surrounding spiritual energy being torn apart by that诡异 force. However, just as he was about to be sucked into the abyss, a familiar figure slowly emerged from the depths of the Void—a figure with hands clasped behind their back, a meaningful smile playing at the corners of their lips. Cang Yutian stood there as if this world-ending catastrophe was merely another piece being placed on the chessboard. 'Long time no see, everyone.' The voice was cold as ever, yet it sparked an inexplicable chill in Chen Ji's heart. He saw Ye Qing's face turn deathly pale, saw Su Qingyao's sword blade trembling slightly, while Cang Yutian simply stood there motionless, his eyes reflecting three disheveled figures, his expression so indifferent it bordered on cruelty. The reunion after ten thousand years had begun in such a manner.

Yet before Chen Ji could speak, a blinding blood-colored light erupted from the core of the Fate Vortex. A figure in black robes stepped out from nothingness, surrounded by eerie Demonic Path aura, yet possessing a pair of eyes so clear they seemed transparent, staring directly at Cang Yutian. 'Cang Yutian, ten thousand years.' The voice was hoarse and low, as if corroded by too many years. 'You imprisoned me for ten thousand years, refined my companions, yet never imagined I would be waiting for you at this convergence point of fate.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted—this was the Demonic Path Commander? That supreme being who legend said was sealed by Cang Yutian's own hands? He noticed that as the other spoke, their gaze flicked unnoticeably to the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand, as if it held some profound meaning.

dialogue.content: 'Waiting for me?' Cang Yutian laughed lightly, his smile carrying undisguised mockery. 'You're just a stray dog, hiding and eking out an existence for ten thousand years. Coming out voluntarily today—are you tired of living?' He raised his hand, the Void quaking, a pressure capable of crushing heaven and earth poured down. Yet the Demonic Path Commander remained motionless, slowly shaking his head: 'Cang Yutian, do you truly believe you are still that supreme being who held dominion over the Heavenly Dao ten thousand years ago?' He paused, his gaze sweeping toward Chen Ji. 'The inheritor of the Tianji Record, do you wish to know where your 'Tianji Record' came from? Do you wish to know why every generation of Chess Player has failed to escape the fate of being refined?'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart plummeted. He sensed the monstrous waves contained within the Demonic Path Commander's words, each character striking like a heavy hammer against the carefully constructed defenses of his heart over the years. Chess Player, refined, fate—these terms had never been recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment, yet this mysterious Demonic Path expert had casually unveiled them. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng had said: 'You don't need to know the truth of the Tianji Record yet.' Not that he didn't need to know—was it because they dared not let him know? Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the churning emotions, maintaining his harmless 'trash' appearance on the surface, only his fingers hanging at his side slightly curled, knuckles white.

dialogue.content: 'Speak.' Chen Ji's voice was unusually calm, even carrying a hint of carelessness. 'Since the Demonic Path Commander is in the mood to tell stories, Chen is all ears.' He saw Cang Yutian's brow furrow almost imperceptibly—that was the displeasure of a Chess Player when their game is being peeked at. And what Chen Ji wanted was precisely this effect—to make Cang Yutian realize that this chess game's variables were far more numerous than he imagined. The Demonic Path Commander seemed quite satisfied with his reaction, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his lips: 'Good courage.' He turned to face Cang Yutian, his voice suddenly chilling. 'Ten thousand years ago, there were six Chess Players in this world, each holding one volume of the Tianji Record, sharing responsibility for Heaven's operations. And Cang Yutian—he was merely the most insignificant among the six.'

text.content: The Void seemed to freeze in that moment. Chen Ji saw Cang Yutian's smile freeze on his face, a cold glint of malignancy flashing for the first time in those perpetually indifferent eyes. 'Continue.' Chen Ji added opportunely, his tone casual, yet like a dull blade slowly cutting into Cang Yutian's proud self-esteem. The Demonic Path Commander burst into laughter, the sound carrying ten thousand years of pent-up sorrow and resentment: 'Ten thousand years ago, Cang Yutian discovered a secret—when the fate fragments of six Chess Players were gathered together, they could reshape the Heavenly Dao, making him the true ruler of all things.' He paused deliberately, each word like a hammer. 'So he laid a poisoned scheme, refining us five one by one, devouring our fate fragments.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply in that instant. Fate fragments, reshaping the Heavenly Dao—these pieces of information created a certain eerie resonance with the incomplete Tianji Record in his hands. He suddenly understood why none of the previous Chess Players could die in peace, why the Tianji Record chose a 'trash' as its inheritor. Not because of fate, but because Cang Yutian needed it—he needed to constantly create new Chess Players, constantly harvest fate fragments, to resist the Heavenly Dao's backlash. 'And I am the sixth.' The Demonic Path Commander's voice pulled Chen Ji back from his thoughts. 'I escaped his pursuit at the cost of splitting my soul, yet was trapped at the edge of the Heavenly Realm for ten thousand years.' He looked down at his illusory hands. 'This is the price of Cang Yutian's ascension to godhood—our flesh and blood, our fate, our ten thousand years of time.'

dialogue.content: 'Enough.' Cang Yutian's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, his aura surging, the Void beginning to crack inch by inch. Yet the Demonic Path Commander showed not a trace of fear, instead stepping forward, blood-colored light condensing into an indestructible barrier around him. 'What's the rush?' He scoffed. 'Cang Yutian, do you really think your power compares to what it was ten thousand years ago?' He pointed to the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand. 'How many of those fate fragments you devoured have been lost with the Tianji Record's fragmentation? You imprisoned me for ten thousand years, yet also weakened yourself.' Chen Ji keenly captured the keywords in this speech—fragment loss, power weakening. Cang Yutian's weakness had been so nakedly exposed before him.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart raced in that instant. As a Chess Player who left nothing to chance, he understood too well the value of this intelligence. Cang Yutian's strength was built upon fate fragments, and every fragmentation of the Tianji Record, every circulation of a torn page, meant the loss of those fragments. If what the Demonic Path Commander said was true, then this 'Ultimate Chess Player's power was far from being as unshakeable as it appeared. He recalled the Heavenly Fate Value consumed each time the Tianji Record was used—was that not another manifestation of fate fragments? And where did those consumed 'Heavenly Fate Values' flow to?

Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged glances, both seeing deep shock in each other's eyes. Though they didn't fully understand the mysteries behind this dialogue, they sensed the subtle shift in the situation. Cang Yutian was no longer an invincible existence, and Chen Ji seemed to hold a key that could leverage the entire chess game. Ye Qing silently moved half a step closer to Chen Ji, Demonic Path mist悄然 forming a thin barrier around the two of them—this was her silent declaration of allegiance, her way of showing her stance through action.

dialogue.content: 'What's the point of saying all this?' Cang Yutian coldly laughed, his aura not diminishing but increasing instead. 'Even with some loss of power, crushing you ants is still more than sufficient.' He raised his hand, a light containing world-destroying force condensing in his palm. 'Inheritor of the Tianji Record, do you think knowing this will change anything? The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has long since written the fate of everyone here—including your sister Chen Nian, who now lies in the depths of the Holy Sect, waiting to become the next vessel for fate fragments.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted to the size of pinpoints in that instant. Chen Nian—this name was like a sharp blade, cruelly stabbing into the soft underbelly he had carefully hidden for ten years.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian mentioning Chen Nian caused Chen Ji's heart to tremble violently, yet his expression remained placid. At this moment, the Demonic Path Commander was awaiting his response—

dialogue.content: 'Chen Nian's affairs, I will handle personally.' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, each word seemingly taken from an ice cellar. 'Now, continue telling me what you know. Cang Yutian's weakness—it can't be something as simple as fragment loss, right?' He stared directly into the Demonic Path Commander's clear eyes, a faint arc curving at the corner of his lips. 'Since you dared show yourself here, you must have a method to deal with him.'

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander paused slightly, then burst into hearty laughter: 'Excellent! Excellent Chen Ji!' His laughter carried a hint of appreciation and anticipation. 'Worthy of being a Chess Player who could reach this point—you are far smarter than Cang Yutian imagined.' He收敛笑意, his gaze sharpening like a blade. 'Indeed, besides fate fragments, Cang Yutian's power source has another foundation—the authorization of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. He is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' agent in the mortal world. Once this identity is stripped away...'

dialogue.content: "Demon Path Commander." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice not loud but clearly piercing through the void's tremors, "You want to reclaim your soul trapped for ten thousand years, and I want to save my sister—we have a common enemy." He paused slightly, eyes gleaming with sharp light, "How about cooperation?" The speech was straightforward, without any beating around the bush. Ye Qing's eyes flickered with surprise—was this still that "trash" who would shrink back at the first sign of trouble?

text.content: The Demon Path Commander froze for a moment, then burst out laughing: "Hahaha! Interesting!" His laughter echoed through the vortex of fate, even drowning out the roar of the collapsing void, "Ten thousand years, and finally someone dares to form an alliance with this old man against Cang Yutian!" He pointed at Chen Ji, "With such courage, this old man has set his sights on half of that ten-thousand-year soul!" Cang Yutian's expression finally darkened, cold light appearing in his eyes: "Alliance? Do you think a few empty words can change anything?"

choices.text: Questioning the Demon Path Commander's motives
choices.description: Do not trust anyone easily, continue to deeply explore the true purpose behind the information revealed by the Demon Path Commander, remain vigilant.

choices.visible_reward: See through the opponent's true intentions

dialogue.content: "Wait." Chen Ji suddenly raised his hand, interrupting the topic about to unfold further, "Demon Path Commander, you say these things because you want to cooperate with me—but I'm curious." He tilted his head, a playful smile appearing on that ordinary face, "You've been trapped for ten thousand years, hating Cang Yutian to the bone, yet you appear now—is this really just a coincidence?" He paused, "Or have you been waiting for this opportunity—for the Tianji Record to appear again, for a new chess player to emerge?"

text.content: The Demon Path Commander's smile stiffened for an instant, then deepened: "You're quite cautious." He didn't deny it, simply standing with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying more scrutiny, "Indeed, I was waiting. Waiting for the Tianji Record to reunite, waiting for the chess player to mature, waiting for a variable capable of tilting the chess game." He changed direction, "But so what? The enemy of my enemy is my friend—our goals align, we each take what we need, what's not to like?"

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. The other party's words were impeccable, yet they precisely proved his judgment—the Demon Path Commander was no saint, and his cooperation would inevitably be built on self-interest. But for now, Chen Ji needed this piece. "I've noted it." He finally spoke, his tone calm yet profound, "Each taking what they need is fine. But let me be clear—if your plans harm the people around me, I won't hesitate to give Cang Yutian one more ally."

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's patience finally ran out. He sneered, the destructive light in his palm suddenly erupting, directly targeting the connection point between Chen Ji and the Demon Path Commander—he wanted to strangle the alliance in its cradle before it could form. However, the Demon Path Commander was早有防备, the blood-colored barrier instantly expanding, the two forces colliding mid-air with a shockwave powerful enough to tear the sky apart. Ye Qing immediately pulled Su Qingyao into the demonic mist, while Chen Ji took advantage of the shockwave's cover to silently activate the Tianji Record Fragment—he wanted to know what would happen within three hours.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment grew warm in his palm, Chen Ji's consciousness instantly pulled into that familiar chaotic void. However, this time, the scenes he saw were entirely different from before—no clear future visions, only fragmented silhouettes flickering before his eyes. He saw Cang Yutian bound by countless chains deep in the Heavenly Realm, saw six destiny fragments slowly converging in the air, and saw... Chen Nian's blurry figure standing before a gate leading to the unknown. "Heavenly Fate -5." The mechanical voice rang in his mind, Chen Ji猛地 opened his eyes, discovering his forehead already covered with fine cold sweat. Heavenly Fate had dropped to seventy-five—the chess game before him was far more dangerous than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: The future shown by the Tianji Record was unclear, but Chen Ji caught the key information. The battle between the Demon Path Commander and Cang Yutian continued, and he had to make a choice—

Before Su Qingyao could react, she saw that平日里 timid figure burst forth with astonishing speed, a short blade somehow already in his hand, directly targeting Cang Yutian's back heart. "You—" Cang Yutian's eyes flashed with shock, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to strike at this moment. He had to divide his attention, his offensive suddenly stagnating. The Demon Path Commander seized the opportunity, transforming the blood-colored barrier into countless sword rays, sweeping across like a tide.

text.content: "Insignificant tricks." Cang Yutian冷哼一声, golden light erupting around him, actually blocking the combined attack of the two. But in the instant his figure微微晃动, Chen Ji caught the flicker of wariness in Cang Yutian's eyes—real. Cang Yutian's power was indeed declining, otherwise he wouldn't need to seriously respond even to this "trash's" strike. "Interesting." Chen Ji's lips curled into a cold smile, and in Ye Qing and Su Qingyao's eyes, there was an indescribable sharp aura.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not move. He quietly stepped back half a pace, concealing himself within Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist, coldly observing the peak confrontation before him. Every strike exchanged between the Demonic Path Commander and Cang Yutian was enough to tear apart the heavens, but what Chen Ji noticed was another detail—Cang Yutian's attacks were weakening with each strike, while the Demonic Path Commander's blood-colored barrier grew increasingly solid. As one declined and the other rose, the scales of victory were slowly tilting. "Wait a bit longer," he silently urged in his heart. "Cang Yutian, how long can you hold on?"

text.content: Ye Qing quietly drew closer to him by half a step, her voice pressed extremely low: "You saw through it long ago?" She gazed at the figure shuttling through the golden light and blood-colored radiance, a complex light flickering in her eyes. "Cang Yutian is deliberately stalling for time—what is he waiting for?" Chen Ji did not answer. He merely lowered his gaze to the scorching hot Tianji Record Fragment in his palm. Mo Xiansheng's warning seemed to still echo in his ears: the chess game from ten thousand years ago never truly ended. And he was stepping into that larger chessboard one step at a time.

choices.text: Secretly preparing the Tianji Record as a killing move
choices.description: Quietly guide the power of the Tianji Record to converge, searching for an opportunity to determine the outcome with a single strike, accomplishing everything in one decisive move.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his fingertips gently tracing across the Tianji Record Fragment, silently guiding the power contained within. He knew that with his current strength, confronting Cang Yutian head-on would be no different from an egg striking a rock. But if he could gather enough power from the fragments of destiny... The patterns on the fragment began to glow faintly, emanating an ancient and dangerous aura. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly echoed in his mind: "Enough, Chen Ji. Your body cannot withstand that kind of power at present." Chen Ji's fingers paused, yet did not stop—some risks are worth taking.

text.content: Cang Yutian seemed to sense something, his gaze abruptly sweeping toward Chen Ji's direction, a flash of alarm and uncertainty flickering in his eyes. He felt it—a power sufficient to threaten him was gathering in secret, and this power originated from the Tianji Record, from those fragments of destiny that rightfully belonged to him! "Stop!" he roared, his offensive suddenly intensifying, forcing even the Demonic Path Commander to respond with full force. Yet Chen Ji merely raised his head, offering him a harmless smile: "Why the rush, senior? The good show is just beginning."

dialogue.content: At the moment of stalemate between both sides, the core of the Destiny Vortex suddenly erupted with a thunderous roar. A massive rift tore open in the Void, dense Heavenly Dao aura pouring forth from within. Almost simultaneously, both Cang Yutian and the Demonic Path Commander changed their expressions. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao..." Cang Yutian murmured, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. The Demonic Path Commander, however, burst into laughter, his voice carrying a hint of madness: "It's here! Cang Yutian, did you think the Eye of Heavenly Dao would stand on your side forever?" He turned to gaze at Chen Ji, his eyes blazing with light. "Chess Player, this is your final chance—choose which side to stand on?"

choice.prompt: The aura of the Eye of Heavenly Dao descended. Cang Yutian and the Demonic Path Commander both turned to Chen Ji, awaiting his choice. At this moment, he must make the choice that changes destiny—

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, gazing at the will slowly descending from the celestial rift. That was an existence beyond everything, the true Heavenly Dao itself—yet this Chen Ji had never believed in fate. He turned to look at the Demonic Path Commander, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Pleasant cooperation." Four words, crisp and decisive, without the slightest hesitation. The Demonic Path Commander froze for a moment, then threw his head back in wild laughter, his voice echoing through the shattered Void: "Good! Good! Good! This old one has waited for this day for ten thousand years!"

text.content: "Chen Ji!" For the first time, a hint of urgency appeared in Cang Yutian's voice. "Do you know what you're doing? To become an enemy of the Eye of Heavenly Dao is to become an enemy of the entire Heavenly Dao! You will never find salvation for eternity!" Yet Chen Ji merely gazed at him calmly, his eyes reflecting the descending will, his expression so indifferent it bordered on mockery: "Senior, you imprisoned the Chess Player for ten thousand years, refined innocent people—that debt, if Heaven will not settle it, I will." He paused. "As for never finding salvation for eternity—my Chen Ji's life has always been determined by none but myself."

choices.text: Remain neutral and propose a deal
choices.description: Do not directly take sides, but instead propose a trade with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, exchanging his power for greater benefits.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not accept this

dialogue.content: "Wait." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice not loud yet clearly penetrating the roaring Void. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao, Cang Yutian, and the Demonic Path Commander—since all three of you are here, Chen has a proposal." He surveyed the three parties, wearing his usual harmless smile. "What the Eye of Heavenly Dao desires is the reunification of the Tianji Record. What Cang Yutian desires are the fragments of destiny. And what the Demonic Path Commander desires is the completeness of his soul—your three objectives are not conflicting. Why must you fight to the death?"

text.content: Three gazes fell upon Chen Ji simultaneously, carrying scrutiny, suspicion, and wariness. Chen Ji paid no heed, continuing to speak: 'I can help all of you achieve your desires—but the condition is that Chen Nian must be safe and sound.' He gazed at the descending will, his eyes flickering with sharp light, 'This is a transaction, not a request.' The air seemed to freeze for an instant, and the will of the Heavenly Eye appeared to be seriously considering this young chess player's proposal.

choices.text: Feign compliance, seek an opportunity to escape

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, his posture perfectly respectful: 'Chen Ji is willing to follow the arrangements of the Heavenly Eye.' His voice was calm and submissive, like a devout believer praying to a deity. Yet the moment he lowered his head, fingers hidden in his sleeve secretly activated a talisman—Mo Xiansheng's life-saving artifact capable of tearing through the void at a critical moment. He didn't need to gamble his life here; his younger sister was still waiting for him.

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's smile froze instantly, his eyes flashing with an incredible anger and disappointment: 'Chen Ji! You—' Before he could finish, Cang Yutian burst into laughter, the sound dripping with mockery and malicious pleasure: 'Hahaha! See? This is the chess player you selected! At the critical moment, still that useless waste!' Yet Chen Ji kept his head bowed, a slight smirk curling at the corner of his mouth—let Cang Yutian enjoy his triumph; this grudge, he would remember.

dialogue.content: Just as the situation fell into a subtle stalemate, an eerie fluctuation suddenly emanated from the core of the fate vortex. A blurry figure slowly coalesced in the depths of the void—a girl's silhouette—her features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, yet her eyes were a desolate emptiness. 'Chen Nian!' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was a name that had haunted his soul for ten years, his deepest vulnerability. The girl's form flickered in the void, as if on the verge of dissolution at any moment, only those hollow eyes gazing directly at him, lips trembling but producing no sound.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart being gripped by an invisible hand. Ten years—ten years of patience, scheming, meticulous planning, all for this single purpose: to find Chen Nian. Yet now she stood there, so close yet impossibly far. He saw Cang Yutian's satisfied smile, the Heavenly Eye's seemingly manipulative will, and a flicker of struggle in Chen Nian's eyes—she was trying to tell him something, yet crushed by an invisible force. 'Chen Ji, this is your sister's final soul remnant.' Cang Yutian's voice drifted over, 'Want to save her? Surrender the Tianji Record, and I'll release her.'

Ye Qing quietly gripped Chen Ji's wrist, her fingertips cold yet conveying unwavering strength. Su Qingyao's sword blocked the way, her eyes filled with vigilance as she gazed at the girl's figure. Yet Chen Ji stood motionless, silently observing the sister he had only dared to dream of for a decade, his eyes churning with storms. He understood perfectly—Cang Yutian was forcing his hand, using his most cherished person to extract his compliance. But this was also an opportunity, a chance to see his enemies clearly. He slowly lifted his head, staring directly into Cang Yutian's determined eyes, his lips barely moving as he uttered two words: 'No surrender.'

Two simple words, yet exploding like thunderclaps through the void. The Demonic Path Commander froze for an instant, then burst into unrestrained laughter, the sound filled with appreciation and satisfaction. Cang Yutian's expression froze, disbelief flickering in his eyes—he had expected Chen Ji to crumble like any mortal, surrendering to familial ties. Yet Chen Ji only gazed steadily at the girl's spectral form, his voice terrifyingly composed: 'Chen Nian has waited ten years. This moment means nothing.' His eyes suddenly blazed with cold fury, 'But Cang Yutian, using her to threaten me—this debt, I will make you repay a hundredfold.'

Chen Nian's form seemed to tremble imperceptibly, a barely perceptible light flickering in those vacant eyes—relief, pride, or something else, Chen Ji couldn't tell. But just as Cang Yutian's expression darkened and he was about to strike, a deafening roar erupted from the depths of the fate vortex. An ancient, authoritative voice resounded through the void, echoing in everyone's ears: 'Enough.' The words were calm, yet carried undeniable power, 'Cang Yutian, your time is up.' Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice. But this time, not a warning, but a judgment.

Just as Chen Ji was absorbing Mo Xiansheng's earth-shattering words, an eerie fluctuation suddenly emanated from the depths of the fate vortex. A familiar figure stepped forth from nothingness—Mo Xiansheng, manifesting as a remnant soul, ancient runes of the Tianji Record coiling around him. His gaze swept across the gathered experts before settling on Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: 'Chen Ji, you've done well.' His voice was ancient and weary, 'But what follows should not be your burden to bear.' Before he could finish, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul blazed with unprecedented light, a force capable of shaking heaven and earth descending abruptly. Cang Yutian's expression contorted drastically, his voice sharp: 'You're mad!' Yet Mo Xiansheng only smiled faintly, looking at Chen Ji: 'Remember, the truth of the Tianji Record... lies not in the past, but in...' His voice cut off abruptly, Mo Xiansheng's form dissolving into a stream of light, hurtling into the core of the fate vortex.
